nodes.title: SG-1.3 Add the PNG generation script and manifest update
nodes.body:
Context: gridToRgba (frontend/src/lib/gridToRgba.ts), buildSpriteSheet (frontend/src/lib/spriteSheet.ts) and the shared PALETTE (frontend/src/lib/palette.ts) exist, but there is no PNG encoder, no grid source files, no script and no npm script. The manifest at game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json only lists SVGs. Desired behavior: a script reads grid sources, encodes PNGs with no timestamps, writes them under game/frontend/public/assets and rewrites manifest entries with path, size and frame data. Why: later cycles replace placeholder art with generated PNGs.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the grid sources, when the script runs twice, then every PNG file has identical bytes
- Given a generated PNG, when its IHDR is read, then width and height equal the manifest entry dimensions
- Given a sheet source, when the manifest is rewritten, then the entry holds path, dimensions and frameWidth, frameHeight, frameCount
- Given package.json, when scripts are read, then an art:generate npm script runs the generator


## Scope
- In scope: PNG encoder
- In scope: grid source registry
- In scope: generator plan and manifest merge
- In scope: script and npm script
- Out of scope: new rooms
- Out of scope: story content
- Out of scope: backend
- Out of scope: audio
- Out of scope: deployment
- Out of scope: repository clean-up
- Out of scope: redrawing the room art
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin and guard tests
- Preserve: existing manifest entries not produced by a source
- Preserve: gridToRgba and buildSpriteSheet behavior


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix, Zustand stay
- All art is raster pixel art generated in-repo from source data; no downloaded art, image services or CDN links
- One shared palette of at most 48 colours; sources use palette indices only
- Scene content stays data-driven
- Tests are unit tests with dependencies mocked


## Dependencies
- SG-1.1 palette (done)
- SG-1.2 gridToRgba and buildSpriteSheet (done)


## Definition of done
- All requirements delivered with passing unit tests


## Non-functional requirements
- Output is byte-identical across runs on the same Node version


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Pure PNG encoder writes timestamp-free deterministic bytes and reads its own header size
nodes.body:
Context: no PNG encoder exists and no PNG library is a dependency. Desired behavior: a pure function encodes an RgbaImage into a PNG (signature, IHDR, one IDAT via node:zlib at fixed level, IEND) with no tIME or text chunks, and a helper reads width and height from the IHDR. Why: determinism and header checks are the sub-goal's test targets.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the same RgbaImage, when encodePng runs twice, then both byte arrays are equal
- Given a 4x3 image, when readPngSize reads the encoded bytes, then it returns width 4 and height 3
- Given the encoded bytes, when chunk types are listed, then only IHDR, IDAT and IEND appear


## Scope
- In scope: encodePng
- In scope: readPngSize
- In scope: CRC32
- Out of scope: PNG decoding of pixels
- Out of scope: palette PNG colour types
- Preserve: RgbaImage type from gridToRgba


## Technical constraints
- No new npm dependency; use node:zlib
- Phaser stays on 3.90.x and the existing stack stays


## Dependencies
- frontend/src/lib/gridToRgba.ts


## Definition of done
- Encoder exported and typed


## Non-functional requirements
- Pure: no clock, no randomness, no fs


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Grid sources become PNG files and manifest entries with real size and frame data
nodes.body:
Context: no grid source files exist. Desired behavior: src/art/sources.ts exports palette-indexed grid sources (id, path, frames); a pure generateAssets turns them through gridToRgba, buildSpriteSheet and encodePng into file bytes plus manifest entries; mergeManifest replaces entries by id and keeps others. Why: gives the script a testable core.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a source with 4 frames of 32x48, when planned, then the entry has dimensions 128x48 and frames 32,48,4 and type spritesheet
- Given a single-frame source, when planned, then the entry is type image with its dimensions
- Given a manifest holding the same id, when merged, then that entry is replaced in place and other entries stay unchanged
- Given a source with an index beyond the palette, when planned, then it throws


## Scope
- In scope: art source registry with one seed hand-cursor source
- In scope: generateAssets
- In scope: mergeManifest
- Out of scope: the room, boy and UI art sets
- Out of scope: removing placeholder SVGs
- Preserve: existing manifest entries and schema


## Technical constraints
- Sources use indices into the shared PALETTE of at most 48 colours
- Manifest entries must satisfy assetSchema in game/src/assets/manifest/schema.ts
- All art generated in-repo; no downloaded art


## Dependencies
- REQ-1


## Definition of done
- Entries validate against assetSchema


## Non-functional requirements
- Output order follows source order


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · art:generate script writes PNGs and the manifest, and is wired as an npm script
nodes.body:
Context: package.json has no generator command. Desired behavior: runGenerateArt(deps) generates assets, writes each PNG under the assets root and rewrites the manifest JSON with two-space indent and trailing newline; scripts/generateArt.ts wires node:fs; package.json gets art:generate. Why: this is the real entry point that reaches the new code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given fake IO, when runGenerateArt runs twice, then the written bytes of each file are equal
- Given fake IO, when it runs, then the manifest written parses and holds an entry per source
- Given package.json, when read, then scripts.art:generate equals vite-node scripts/generateArt.ts


## Scope
- In scope: runGenerateArt
- In scope: scripts/generateArt.ts
- In scope: art:generate npm script
- Out of scope: running in CI
- Out of scope: deployment
- Preserve: existing npm scripts


## Technical constraints
- Assets root is game/frontend/public/assets; manifest is game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json
- No CDN or image service; deterministic output


## Dependencies
- REQ-1
- REQ-2


## Definition of done
- npm run art:generate works from game/frontend


## Non-functional requirements
- Finishes in seconds


## Clarifying questions
- None

readPngSize returns the encoded width and height

steps.action: Add a module-level 256-entry CRC table, crc32(bytes) and chunk(type, data) returning length(4 BE)+type+data+crc over type+data.

Export encodePng(img: RgbaImage): Uint8Array that writes the 8-byte signature, IHDR (width, height, bit depth 8, colour type 6, 0,0,0), one IDAT of deflateSync of rows each prefixed by filter byte 0 with level 9, then IEND; no other chunks.
Export readPngSize(bytes) returning {width,height} read big-endian from offsets 16 and 20; throw Error('not a png') when the signature differs.
